profile.headline: Technology leader redefining e-commerce by leading high-performing, collaborative Experimentation Teams | Software Engineering | GenAI | e-commerce | Agile/DevOps | CSM | ICP-FDO | AeroIT | Mentor | Writer | Volunteer
profile.summary:
Vernee Green-Myers is a highly accomplished I.T. leader with over 30 years of progressive, diverse experience leading high-performing Software Engineering, Quality Assurance, and DevOps teams across global omnichannel retail, communications, and financial sectors. She is a proven leader in driving significant incremental revenue and business value through rapid, high-impact experimentation and optimization of customer-facing applications.

At The Home Depot, Vernee drove $22 million in incremental revenue and achieved a 3.92% increase in clickthrough rate during the critical Black Friday through Cyber Monday period. She was instrumental in generating $690 million in revenue for Spring Black Friday by leading new initiatives that increased clickthrough rate by 2.5% and total visits by 15%. Her expertise includes leveraging Generative AI and automation to streamline development processes, ensuring projects are delivered on time and under budget.

Vernee has a strong foundation in enterprise stability, having directed all Software Engineering and SQA teams, including Production Support, and executed a high-impact quality initiative to reduce the Defect Escape Rate from 57% to 22%. Earlier in her career, she established Software Quality Assurance for a rapidly growing company, achieving a 76% improvement in Software Quality and increasing Automation Test Coverage from 32% to 68%.

From her deep technical roots in core IT operations and early adoption of emerging technologies—like transitioning from Mainframe to a PC network environment—to her executive leadership, Vernee is a strategic force in defining IT strategies, leveraging Agile methodologies, and ensuring stability through strong Incident Management and large-scale ERP implementation.

A graduate of Shorter College, Vernee is currently based in Armuchee, GA, and is a proud mother and grandmother, passionate about food, and past writer for long-running food magazine.

positions.title: Software Engineer Manager, Experimentation and Personalization Platforms
positions.description:
As the Software Engineering Manager for the Experimentation Platform, I lead a high-performing team at the heart of The Home Depot's digital innovation. My role is focused on building and scaling the centralized, web-scale services that empower teams across the company to make data-driven decisions and shape the future of e-commerce for millions of customers.

My first four months have been instrumental in driving the technical vision and execution of a new hybrid server-side experimentation platform, achieving significant milestones:

🔹 **Pioneered a Hybrid Experimentation Platform:** Successful pilot of a state-of-the-art A/B testing platform using Akamai EdgeWorkers and the Adobe Target SDK, enabling rapid and reliable innovation.

🔹 **Ensured Platform Resiliency & Data Integrity:** My team authored destructive/load test plans and established rigorous go-live checklists. Championed data integrity by leading a decisive rollback of a campaign that revealed an eligibility bias, reinforcing a culture of trustworthy results.

🔹 **Executed Complex, High-Traffic A/B Pilots:** Coordinated and delivered a server-side A/B pilot on the high-traffic Fusion Product Information Pages (PIP), managing numerous RFCs and driving cross-functional SRE engagement to keep the test on schedule.

🔹 **Established Rigorous Performance & Analytics Standards:** Drove the creation of New Relic dashboards to measure Core Web Vitals (CWV), establishing a high bar for quality that requires all experiments to be optimized for performance before scaling.

Technical Environment: Akamai EdgeWorkers, Adobe Target (TnT), A/B Testing, New Relic, GCP, Jira, ServiceNow, React, Next.js, Neoload

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager - Header, Homepage, and Event Optimization
positions.description:
•	Lead and empower cross-functional teams responsible for developing and maintaining high-traffic, customer-facing online shopping applications, directly supporting the multi-billion-dollar omnichannel business strategy. 
•	Collaborate with multiple content teams utilizing a headless CMS to allow fast and reliable updates on the Homepage with new banners, featured products, and promotions.  
•	Event Optimization drove $22M in incremental revenue and achieved a 3.92% (400 bps) increase in clickthrough during the critical Black Friday through Cyber Monday period by rapidly deploying Black Friday Theming and promotions. 
•	Spring Event Optimization resulted in $690M revenue for Spring Black Friday, up 28% vLY by leveraging new Bento Hero and theming for Spring Black Friday 2025.  This refreshed experience increased clickthrough rate by 2.5% and visits of 116M, up by 15%. 
•	Increased new credit accounts by 15% and credit center traffic by 6% year-overyear by strategically reintroducing a key link on the Desktop B2C header outside of the code freeze window. 
•	Optimized customer conversion flows, resulting in a significantly improved PIP Order Sample Add-to-Cart (ATC) Rate (71.74%) and PLP Order Sample ATC Rate (85.76%). 
•	Collaborate with Product and Design teams to define roadmaps and utilized a headless CMS to ensure fast, reliable updates of banners and promotions across the Homepage. 
•	Mentor and coach engineers, fostering professional growth, building a highperforming engineering culture, and resulting in improved Voice of Associate (VOA) scores. 
•	Proactively identify and resolve technical challenges, leveraging Generative AI and automation to optimize development processes and ensure projects consistently delivered on time and under budget.

positions.title: Author of Monthly Column "Southern Girls BBQ Roadshow"
positions.description:
Author of monthly column in national publication recording my adventures looking for the best BBQ, Pub Grub, and comfort food across America.  My adventures started on Pennsylvania Avenue in Washington, DC where I attended my first festival that included "competition BBQ."  Who had ever heard of such a thing?  As a participant on a team that won Nation's best bbq sauce and placed in several categories including Whole Hog, I was bit by the BBQ and food competition 
bug.  Continuing my journey as a ertified BBQ judge and Contest Rep for Memphis Barbecue Network, a BBQ Judge and Table Captain in KCBS, a certified Steak Cookoff Association judge and fan of World Food Championships.  I met the most renowned legends in BBQ and visited some award-winning restaurants.  However, the real adventures begin when you stop at unknown bbq shacks, mom-and-pop joints, and unpretentious food trucks.  "So grab your boots and let's go!"

positions.title: Senior Manager of Software Engineering/DevOps
positions.description:
Returned from Covid (one-month) furlough to manage Software Engineering teams including Billing, DataFeeds, WHQ Features, WHQ Tech Debt, Production Support, and Data Insights.
• Participate in product development meetings to add value from software development and quality
• Realigned key engineers from SaaS and Enterprise Apps into Features, Tech Debt, and ProductSupport teams to efficiently address business concerns caused by COVID-19 furloughs and reduction in staff
• Ensured validated deliverables meet functional and design specifications and requirements
• Changed Production Support team from Scrum to Kanban to increase throughput
• Created cross-training plan between Engineering teams to reduce single points of failure
• Augmented staff with contractors and transitioned many contract-to-hire positions
• Reduced Defect Escape Rate from 57% to 22% in 90 days
• Increased QA Automation coverage from 10% to 60% in 90 days

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Manager
positions.description:
Brought in to implement Software Quality standards, QA Automation and Release Management strategies 
• Provide strategic direction for QA team and mentor team members
• Develop end-to-end testing strategies in an Agile SDLC environment
• Work with key product stakeholders as part of a scrum team to deliver quality software products
• Identify any potential quality issues per defined process and escalate potential quality issues
• Closely work with QA, Software Engineers, Product Owners, and Engineering Management to deliver manual and automated testing solutions
• Identify risks to quality, budget and timeline and manage to reduce risks and impacts

positions.title: Senior Manager of SQA & DevOps
positions.description: Recruited, hired, and led the best collaborative team of DevOps Engineers, Quality Assurance Engineers, SQA Automation Engineers, Release Managers, and Technical Writers to support the company strategy and continued growth to become the largest medi-share provider, an alternative to traditional medical insurance.  Led the team to implement standardized SDLC while reducing the development cycle time from concept to delivery using Lean Six Sigma and Lean methodologies.  After mastering agile and lean, we began implementing DevOps Methodology to improve agile planning, continuous integration, continuous delivery, deploying infrastructure/configuration as code, triggering automated regression testing with daily commits, and implemented slack for monitoring and logging.  Success was achieved by using Jira to integrate with Test Rail, Github, and Bitbucket pipelines for "push button releases" to deploy to pre-production sandboxes and production environment three times a  week -  while reducing defects leaked rate to 12% or less.

positions.title: Manager of Software Quality Assurance and Release Management
positions.description: Recruited to create and Implement a standardized SDLC process for a rapidly growing private company that experienced exponential growth when customers were looking for an affordable alternative to "Obama Care."   Grew the team from one brilliant manual Software QA Tester by selecting best practices for Development and Software Quality Assurance process for Salesforce, Netsuite CRM, and other enterprise applications and hiring the talented engineers.  After standardizing manual QA process, began automation of regression testing.  Following testing transformation, continued with standardized Release Management and hired a technical writer for written Technical Documentation and Online Help.

positions.title: Product Development & Software Quality Assurance - Agile Transformation
positions.description: After the implementation of Jenzabar EX, JICS, and LMS, I became a loyal and happy customer for many years and served on their advisory boards, I decided I loved Jenzabar so much that I went to work for them.  Initially testing their new designed Financial Aid software, used technical specifications and user stories to write test cases, report, and track defects using iterative methodology.  I completed the project ahead of schedule and was asked to join the team permanently.  I worked closely with architects, product managers, and developers to ensure the quality of Jenzabar ERP systems, as well as Jenzabar eLearning, Jenzabar Mobile, and eventually Jenzabar Internet Campus Solution (JICS).  Transferred to the Boston office and became part of first collaborative team to implement Agile Methodology and we led the Agile Transformation.  After completing the first release three months ahead of schedule, I rotated to other divisions to assist in their Agile Transformation.

positions.title: Director of Information Technology
positions.description: Planned, implemented, and managed the overall operation of the Information Technology Department for liberal arts college with four campuses in North Georgia and metro-Atlanta area.  Selected and implemented ERP System with multiple CRMs as well integrated with third-party and open-source solutions.  Other achievements included implementing a reliable network infrastructure, establishing a DRP, creating a helpdesk, implementing a helpdesk software solution, training faculty and staff, bringing the college up-to-date on technology, and implementing a LMS that allowed the college to create new online degree program.  Managed the  Network Administrators, System Administrators, Software Developers, Helpdesk Coordinator, Web Developer, Computer Technicians, and student workers.

positions.title: SQL Database Administrator
positions.description:
• Evaluated new technologies for adoption across four campuses to improve efficiency and scalability.
• Collaborated with IT staff and vendors to implement ERP and CRM solutions successfully.
• Established and led review board sessions to ensure consistency and quality across modules.
• Wrote custom scripts to automate migration, implementation, monitoring, and testing.

positions.description: Worked under the Vice President of International Business Development working with Joint Ventures and International Marketing and Sales Team as liaison between joint ventures and customers in the Asia Pacific and Latin America regions.

positions.title: Software Development, Software Marketing, Production Services, Tech Support, Network Services, Ops
positions.description:
My IT career began by accident when I worked at MILICO as a intern/temporary employee in Agency Audit and called the Helpdesk to ask why the order of input screens did not match the order in the 35-page Life Insurance Agent Application booklet.  The Data Center manager came to offer me a job because I was first person to report the issue.  After my intern was complete, I transferred to the Help Desk while attending Gwinnett Tech.  

Milico eventually became "Primerica Financial Services."  In my seven years, I continually learned new technologies and took on additional responsibilities.  Made several lateral moves and promoted five times in those seven years.

Roles included:
Software Development and Marketing - Developed, tested, and marketed "CallAtlanta" software to Insurance and Mutual Funds Agents.

Software Technical Writer to write the first software manual for CallAtlanta PC-application in Word Perfect. 
 
Production Services Analyst working three 12-hour shifts to coordinate and run production jobs on IBM 3090/400 mainframe and Unix systems.  Would troubleshoot and resolve "abends" (abnormal ending) in production.  Would escalate to systems engineers and programmers as needed.  
Helpdesk Supervisor - Led team of Computer Operators I, II, and III to man 24-hour Helpdesk for largest life insurance provider at the time.  
InfoMgmt Manager - Incident Management of all reported bugs, daily incident meetings, and escalations. 
Master Console Operator - Lead Helpdesk technician responsible for executing and monitoring all production processes.  Would escalate abends to Production Services.
Network Services Analyst - Installed coax, fiber, and network equipment across five buildings.
Computer Operator II - Helpdesk Technician manning Helpdesk at 24/7/365 Data Center.
Computer Operator I - Helpdesk technician executing and monitoring Tape Room, Print Room, and Disaster Recovery jobs.
Agency Audit Specialist - Audited agent applications to ensure compliance.
